cohort: 30 term neonates admitted to the NICU of Pediatrics Department, Zagazig University Hospitals.
finding: While there was an increase in urinary calcium excretion after phototherapy, there was no significant difference in the calcium/creatinine ratio, suggesting that phototherapy did not cause hypercalciuria or hypocalcemia.
mod_finding: There was a statistically significant increase in urine calcium after phototherapy in patients delivered by cesarean section.
